urn:eigenius:core:description: Identity EigenTT term on `jump:OptimisationProblem`. Body is a `program:Var` referencing the bound parameter, so this Lambda has type `OptimisationProblem → OptimisationProblem`. Realises the typed middle `m` of the Symbolics → JuMP Comorphism (D32 §6 generalised): the source-side ExportFormat (`ef_symb_to_jump_input`) already produces a fully-formed OptimisationProblem via `frame_as_optimisation_problem`, so the cross-institution boundary needs no payload translation — the framing on the Symbolics side is what carries the JuMP-side context (variables, bounds, sense, constraints) into the typed shape. Same pattern as `catalyst_to_diffeq:m_id_ode_problem`.

Cross-institution Comorphism — Symbolics → JuMP. The triple (s, m, t) where s = `ef_symb_to_jump_input` (Symbolics-side framing of a `SymbolicsToJuMPInput` to a chain-typed `OptimisationProblem` via `frame_as_optimisation_problem` — identity on the wrapped FormulaTerm), m = `m_id_optimisation_problem` (the identity Lambda on OptimisationProblem), t = `if_jump_optimisation_problem` (JuMP-side reify of the OptimisationProblem payload). The chain-side formalisation of D27 §4.2's natural pairing: a user authors an objective via Symbolics (perhaps as the result of `qc_symb_simplify`), frames it with the optimisation context (variables / bounds / sense / constraints), and pipes the typed result into a JuMP-HiGHS solve. Marked `exact: false` because the framing imposes structure (variables, sense, constraints) not present in the source SymbolicExpression — the typed FormulaTerm content is bit-for-bit preserved, but the comorphism as a whole picks one of many valid framings.
